# #12 Slash menu: blind QA report

**Verdict: PASS.** No blocker or major defects. One minor axe finding and two spec-literal notes.

**How I tested.** I did not read the diff or the #12 src files. I used a throwaway stack (`stack.sh` functions, one prod build reused from `.verify/qa/12/dist`) and Playwright under `browser-slot.sh`. Docs were loaded through `?filePath=` (editor capability) and switched to Edit with `view-toggle-edit`. I read doc text and selection from the live EditorView (`.cm-content`.cmTile.view).

**Scripts** (all under `.verify/qa/12/`):
- `ac.mjs`: 39 checks, 38 passed. The one failure was a bad caret position in my own front-matter fixture, retested below.
- `edge.mjs`: 27 checks, 25 passed. One failure was a missing env var in my harness (fixed and rerun). The other is the spec-literal note in Defects #2.
- `edge2.mjs`: 5 checks, 5 passed.
- `axe.mjs`: axe scan of the open menu.

Command: `.verify/qa/12/run.sh .verify/qa/12/<script>.mjs`.

## Edge cases (all pass unless noted)
- **Triggers:**
  - `/` at doc start, and `/` after a tab, open the menu.
  - Typing `/` over a selection does not open it.
  - Pasting `/table` does not open it.
  - IME composition does not open it.
  - `//` opens with an empty result (query `/`). Acceptable.
- **Fast input:** `/tab⏎` typed with no delay inserts the table.
- **Queries:**
  - `/TABLE` puts table first.
  - Backspacing to an empty query shows the full list again; one more backspace closes the menu.
  - `/é` shows the empty state.
- **Close rules (rule 9):** the menu closes on a space, on a 25-character query (it stays open at 24), on ← past `/`+1 (← inside the query keeps it open), on a click elsewhere, on Shift+← selection, and on blur. Every close leaves the text exactly as typed.
- **Read/Edit switch while open:** the menu disappears and does not come back; the doc stays `/ta`.
- **Remote PUT while open** (shared doc): the doc adopts `REMOTE…` and the menu closes.
- **Indentation:**
  - 4-space-indented `/table` inside a list prefixes every line.
  - 2-space `/code` inside a list ensures a blank line and indents every line.
- **Block insertion mid-text:** `para /toc` before `next` gives `para\n\n[[toc]]\n\nnext`.
- **Text after the query:** text after the query moves onto the new heading line (`abc /h2|tail` → `abc\n## tail`).
- **Menu scrolling and flipping:**
  - Dragging the menu scrollbar keeps the menu open and focus in the editor.
  - The wheel scrolls the menu.
  - Wrapping with ↑ scrolls the date item into view.
  - At the bottom edge the menu flips above the caret (`e-flip.png`).
- **Esc layering:**
  - In focus mode, the first Esc closes only the menu and the second leaves focus mode. The same holds in the language step.
  - With the CM search panel open, Esc closes the menu first.
- **Themes:** I took screenshots in dark, github-dark, locus-dark and locus-light (`theme-*.png`), plus the language step in github-dark, tablet 820×1180, and the phone language step in dark. All are opaque, readable and z-index 200. The phone language step stays inside the viewport.

## Defects
1. **minor:** axe reports `scrollable-region-focusable` (serious impact) on `#slash-menu`, in both light and dark. Focus stays in CM (activedescendant pattern), so keyboard access exists in practice. It will fail any gate test that runs axe scoped to the open menu. Repro: open the menu, then `runAxe(page,{include:'[data-testid=slash-menu]'})`. The language-step menu is clean.
2. **cosmetic (spec-literal):** `abc /h2| tail` (a space after the caret) gives `##  tail` with a double space, because the trailing text keeps its leading whitespace. It renders correctly.
3. **note (spec-literal):** `- /table` commits as `-` plus a blank line plus the table. The literal `- ` counts as "text precedes", which leaves an empty bullet behind.
4. **note:** the language list holds the 48 names and aliases registered in useMarkdown, but not built-in hljs aliases. So `js`+Enter picks `json`, not JavaScript. The spec allows this, but users may be surprised.
